proposed_by: host (Claude Code); a proposal only, not performed
action: Read the authors' source data for Fig 4B (Ras activity, GST-Raf-1-RBD pulldown) of Fritsche-Guenther et al. 2011, file msb201127-df4B.txt in the PMC open-access package (PMC3130559.1), and its legend. Establish which cell lines it contains, and whether it has a BRAF V600E line (HT29 or RKO) with and without a MEK inhibitor against a stated control.
known_about_the_record: erk_pmek_measurement_v0/sources.json lists the file as downloaded with the package ('Fig 4B, Ras activity') and not used. Its content (lines, conditions, values) has not been read in any record here.
The results text read so far reports Ras activation only for Ras-mutated cells: no increase after AZD6244, 2 h, against DMSO (B06, lit-4a9493f38afd). Figures were not read.
The open-access package is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; earlier work kept only identifiers, checksums and copied values, not the files.
why_this_one: It separates the two feedback sites without RC1 or RC2. The stored windows give, in BRAF-mutant cells under MEKi, Ras-GTP 'no_change' for M1 (all_active -> all_active) and 'increase' for M2 (all_inactive -> all_active in all 32 cases, one direction at every step). That is a change of Boolean category, so it needs neither the ordinal reading nor the equal-category = equal-level assumption.
It is a check of an existing public record. If the record holds the answer, no experiment is needed.
D0's planned action (raw Bio-Plex readings) would refine the pMEK readout but would still leave M1's alternation (RC2) and M2's category question on O1 as they are.
not_known: Whether df4B contains any BRAF-mutant line, which inhibitor, dose or time, or how many values.
The time and effort of reading it; access worked in earlier work (sources.json), which is all that is known.

branches.if: df4B shows Ras-GTP higher with the MEK inhibitor than in its control in HT29 or RKO
branches.then: Revise Q-site: feedback acting at RAS is supported in BRAF-mutant lines, which M1 cannot express (its RAS is GF OR KRASmut). M1_R_RAS becomes the rule to re-examine; M2_R_RAS is no longer held as merely possible. This does not establish M2 as a whole: a partial RAS-level feedback added to M1 would show the same.
rests_on: Lito 2012 abstract (lit-453db638b05b, category C): in BRAF V600E melanoma, ERK-dependent feedback suppresses Ras function and RAF inhibition increases Ras-GTP; another tissue and another inhibitor, so plausibility only
readout assumption: Ras-GTP pulldown read as RAS state (case.json readouts)

branches.if: df4B shows no rise (equal, or lower) in HT29 or RKO under the inhibitor
branches.then: Lower M2_R_RAS as the alternative for these lines: its one category-level prediction is not seen. Keep M1 as the base model with the site question decided for now toward RAF. O1 stays held: it still does not count as support for M1 (RC2 unchanged). A 'no increase' wording is read as no increase, not as an exact no change.

branches.if: df4B has no BRAF-mutant line, no inhibitor contrast, or values that cannot be tied to conditions
branches.then: No conclusion on the site; D1 stands unchanged. The question becomes a proposal for a new measurement of Ras-GTP in a BRAF V600E line with and without a MEK inhibitor against vehicle. Dose, time and replicate number are not fixed here: nothing in the records gives a basis for them.

all_branches_differ: Yes: revise toward RAS-level feedback, lower M2, or leave D1 and move to a new measurement.
